nodes.label: Business Rules — U1 Publishable Site Shell
Field error (fail-loudly error naming file and field)
nodes.rationale: A message naming file path and field, collected by SiteBuilder, reported with all others, ending the build before anything is written (ADR-004); never a warning or skipped file.

nodes.label: BR1.1 Only content/ is read as a source of pages
BR1.2 An item is a directory containing index.md
BR1.3 Kind derived from top content directory
BR1.4 Slug is directory name, lowercase kebab ASCII
BR1.5 Slugs unique within a kind
nodes.rationale: Duplicate slugs fail rather than one silently winning.

nodes.label: BR1.6 A draft is draft: true and only that
nodes.rationale: Non-boolean draft is rejected not coerced: a coerced draft: "false" would publish a post the author believes hidden.

nodes.label: BR1.7 A draft produces nothing anywhere
BR1.8 Removing draft line is the only change to publish
BR1.9 Unparseable front matter is a field error
BR2.1 Posts require non-empty title
BR2.2 Posts require one-line summary
BR2.3 Strict ISO YYYY-MM-DD post date within range
nodes.rationale: Strictness chosen at [Q3]: a permissive parser fails silently via day-first vs month-first misordering; the range bound catches mistyped years like 2062 that parse cleanly.

nodes.label: BR2.4 Posts ordered by date desc, ties by slug
BR3.1 Projects require six fields
BR3.2 Project year four-digit within range
BR3.3 tools lists at least one entry
BR3.4 repo is absolute http(s) URL, reachability unchecked
BR3.5 Absent liveUrl omits the rail row
BR3.6 featured optional boolean default false
BR3.7 Projects ordered featured-first, year desc, slug
nodes.rationale: featured orders, never selects, so Home's Projects section can never be empty while projects exist (the launch-day case [Q7] closed).

nodes.label: BR4.1 Build phases load, validate, render, write
nodes.rationale: Validation is a build phase, not a separate command, so it cannot be bypassed (ADR-004).

nodes.label: BR4.2 Every field error in a build is reported
BR4.3 Every field error names file and field
BR4.4 A build with any field error writes nothing
BR4.5 Failed build leaves previous site serving
BR5.1 Global shell on every page, current page marked
BR5.2 Skip link is first focusable element
BR5.3 Home shows 3 recent posts and top 3 projects
BR5.4 Home's two sections structurally equal
BR5.5 Empty section shows sentence and route out
BR5.6 404 page carries shell, served for unmatched paths
BR5.7 Every page type one click from Home
BR5.8 Every page carries title and description
BR5.9 Open Graph/Twitter card tags, no preview image
BR5.10 Exact content-security-policy meta tag on every page
nodes.rationale: Meta-tag form is the only option because GitHub Pages sets no HTTP response headers (C4); value held once in SiteMetadata.

nodes.label: BR5.11 Sitemap lists every published page and no draft
BR5.12 Home intro above both sections
BR6.1 One runner runs all three checks, reports together
BR6.2 Check 2: every non-draft item produced a page
BR6.3 Check 3: internal links resolve
BR6.4 External links never checked
nodes.rationale: External links never block: an unrelated site's outage must not stop publishing (NFR11).

nodes.label: BR6.5 Any failed check blocks
Publishing route (rule actor, not a component)
nodes.rationale: Deployment configuration owned by CI Pipeline (3.7) per components.md and ADR-005; BR7 rules are not verifiable from src/ nor covered by the three checks, verified instead by walking-skeleton conditions 1, 2 and 4.

nodes.label: BR7.1 Push to main is the only publish trigger
BR7.2 No post-push action required of the author
BR7.3 Only a complete build deploys

hyperedges.label: Fail-loudly contract: collect all field errors, write nothing, keep previous site
